|notes=The [[I've Lost Artoo! (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm) (Original 2005)|2005 Gold Edition wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. Gold prints an exclamation point in the cut heading, omits it in its margin, and has no uniqueness dot in either position. The remaster omits the exclamation point and adds the dot to both titles. The underlying Decipher Effect is also unrestricted. Both Set 11 slips print the same Effect game text.
